chapter: Ben Webster and Jim and Andy's
title: Ben Webster's tab
summary: Ben sends $400 from Europe to cover his bar bill.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: I can remember going to Europe, right after Ben left in 1960, in the '60s, Ben Webster left to go to Europe, and he left right from this place where we used to stay, right here where we're doing this tape, this is the last place he lived in the United States. Ben slept right there and we used to have some jam sessions down here. And his passport, after he died, had this as his resident address on it. And I remember going to Europe and seeing Ben in Europe. And he said, when are you going home? And I said, well, in a couple of days I'm going to go back to New York. And he said, well, here, here's $400.00. Take this to Jim and tell him this is on my bill.

And he had probably been in Europe then a year or two. But Jim didn't bother. He knew if Ben got some money, Ben and all, this faithfulness. And I can remember seeing Zoot Simms (inaudible) and they would send money back by me because I'd be coming home a little earlier.
I didn't realize Ben had a tab there, too.
Oh, he had a tab you wouldn't believe, there.
I would believe it. Hard to believe anybody in their right mind would give him a tab.
